node.label: Fatigable weakness of distal limb muscles
node.definition: A type of weakness of a skeletal muscle of distal part of a limb that occurs after a muscle group is used and lessens if the muscle group has some rest. That is, there is diminution of strength with repetitive muscle actions.

evidence.snippet: Autosomal recessive axonal neuropathy with neuromyotonia: Fatigable weakness of distal limb muscles (frequency HP:0040282) [TAS]
Fatigable weakness of distal limb muscles — Frequent (79-30%)
